name: crm-automotivo-mvp
description: Base tecnica do MVP do CRM automotivo conforme Sprint 11 BMAP.

scripts.dev:web: npm run dev:check:web && next dev apps/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run dev:check:api && tsx watch apps/api/src/server.ts
scripts.qa: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.qa:local: npm run qa && npm run qa:regression:local
scripts.qa:daily:local: npm run typecheck && npm run build:api && npm run build:web && npm run qa:commercial:local && npm run qa:customer-history-preferences:local && npm run qa:profile-preferences:local && npm run qa:visual:local
scripts.qa:regression:local: npm run smoke:local && npm run qa:functional:local && npm run qa:commercial:local && npm run qa:customer-history-preferences:local && npm run qa:profile-preferences:local && npm run qa:administrative:local && npm run qa:vehicles:local && npm run qa:services:local && npm run qa:management:local && npm run qa:visual:local
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:smoke
scripts.test:smoke: npm run test:smoke:auth && npm run test:smoke:rate
scripts.test:unit: node --test tests/dev-check.test.mjs tests/prisma-log-level.test.mjs tests/prisma-schema-contract.test.mjs tests/qa-daily-auto-local.test.mjs tests/seed-contract.test.mjs tests/sql-injection-guard.test.mjs
